header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Muhammad Hashim advocate for the petitioner.
body: Learned A.A.G files comments on behalf of respondents alongwith certain documents, taken on record. Mr. Saith Ali advocate files Vakalatnama alongwith comments on behalf of the respondent No.7, taken on record. The respondents in their comments have stated that an inquiry was conducted on the application of the petitioner, same has been admitted by the counsel for the petitioner that the application was moved. Under these circumstances, the instant petition stands disposed of with directions to the official respondents to act strictly in accordance with the law and conduct inquiry fairly, honestly, giving all opportunities of hearing to all the concerned.
